examples.en: He was almost done with the paper, but tomorrow's due date meant it would come down to the wire.
examples.vi: Anh ấy gần viết xong bài, nhưng hạn nộp là ngày mai nên sẽ phải chạy đến phút chót.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

examples.en: Surfing is a popular sport down under.
examples.vi: Lướt sóng là môn thể thao được ưa chuộng ở Úc.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To be unable to recall a required piece of information.

translations.text: đầu óc trống rỗng, không nhớ ra

examples.en: I should know that person's name, but I'm drawing a blank.
examples.vi: Đáng lẽ tôi phải biết tên người đó, nhưng giờ chẳng nhớ ra được.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To delimit a boundary or border.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To set a boundary, rule, or limit, especially on what one will tolerate.

examples.en: I don't mind if they have some fun, but I draw the line at anything that might harm others.
examples.vi: Họ vui chơi thì tôi không phiền, nhưng việc gì có thể hại người khác thì tôi không chấp nhận.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To be selected to do an undesirable task (by drawing the shortest straw or otherwise).

translations.text: xui xẻo bị chọn làm việc chẳng ai muốn

examples.en: I drew the short straw and got stuck doing the whole project alone.
examples.vi: Tôi xui xẻo bốc trúng phần khó và phải một mình làm cả dự án.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Something which has long been desired or hoped for and which has finally happened.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Very fancily or formally dressed; wearing very showy or splendid clothing.

examples.en: He arrived at the gala, dressed to the nines in his top hat and tails.
examples.vi: Ông ấy đến dạ tiệc, diện hết cỡ với mũ chóp cao và áo đuôi tôm.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To negotiate forcefully.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To cause dispute or hostility between people.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To force to leave or go away.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Something of little importance, especially an inconsequential effort or action as compared to a huge problem.

meanings.text: To fail in one's responsibilities or duties, or to make a mistake, especially at a critical point or when the result is very negative.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: A heated, angry, or confused atmosphere calms down.

examples.en: I tried to make amends after the dust settled.
examples.vi: Tôi tìm cách làm hòa sau khi mọi chuyện đã lắng xuống.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Expresses that the speaker must go and deal with something.

translations.text: Có việc phải đi làm rồi

examples.en: Excuse me, gentlemen, but I'm afraid duty calls.
examples.vi: Xin lỗi các anh, e là tôi có việc phải đi rồi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: A person who wakes early or arrives early, typically before most others.

translations.text: người hay dậy sớm, đến sớm

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Relax; do something gently, lightly or carefully; slow down; calm down.

examples.en: Easy does it on the salt. I'm trying to cut down.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To be pregnant

translations.text: đang mang thai, ăn cho cả hai mẹ con

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To end badly.

meanings.text: The final cessation or discontinuance of a process, institution, lineage, or person, especially one which has existed for a considerable period of time; death.

translations.text: bước đường cùng, hồi kết thúc

meanings.text: Any change that seems catastrophic or devastating.

translations.text: chuyện tày trời như tận thế

examples.en: You make it sound as though moving house is the end of the world.
examples.vi: Anh nói cứ như chuyển nhà là tận thế đến nơi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To behave in a manner which favours or which is biased toward.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Regardless of the circumstances (often ones that have just been stated).

examples.en: I'm used to being disappointed, and even then, this is underwhelming.
examples.vi: Tôi quen với thất vọng rồi, vậy mà cái này vẫn thật chán.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: forever, for eternity

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Totally, completely.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: every; without exception (used for emphasis).

translations.text: từng cái một không chừa cái nào

examples.en: He never leaves without checking every last door.
examples.vi: Anh ấy không bao giờ rời đi mà chưa kiểm tra từng cánh cửa một.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Throughout an experience or process.

examples.en: Getting my first job was tough, but my careers advisor helped me every step of the way.
examples.vi: Xin được việc đầu tiên thật khó, nhưng cố vấn nghề nghiệp đã giúp tôi suốt cả chặng đường.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Compensation for injury caused by a person, in the form of inflicting an identical injury on that person.

translations.text: mắt đền mắt, răng đền răng

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To accept or confront the unpleasant consequences of one's actions.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: No more or less than what is stated; a literal or direct meaning or interpretation.

examples.en: Please take this comment at face value and don't try to read anything into it.
examples.vi: Hãy hiểu lời nhận xét này đúng như nó được nói ra và đừng cố suy diễn gì thêm.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: actually, in truth

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: An expression used to concede a point, but suggesting that the broader argument is incorrect.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: A significant amount, often implied to be excessive or inordinate; a great deal of something.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To be affected by paresthesia; to go numb.

examples.en: My left leg has fallen asleep!
examples.vi: Chân trái của tôi bị tê rần rồi!

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To fail to be completed, particularly for lack of interest; to be left out, to suffer from neglect.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To fall from one's current social position to something lower, to lose one's prestige, status or power.

translations.text: thất sủng, mất địa vị và uy tín

examples.en: His father fell from grace with the emperor.
examples.vi: Cha anh ấy đã bị hoàng đế thất sủng.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To make a mistake, a bad decision or act senselessly and get into an extremely difficult situation.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To assume a clear and complete form when separate elements come together; to be fully realized at last.

examples.en: If it weren't for your heroic deed, his evil plan would have fallen into place.
examples.vi: Nếu không nhờ hành động anh hùng của bạn, âm mưu của hắn đã trót lọt đâu vào đấy.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To become the possession of, or be discovered by, an unfriendly third party.

examples.en: The policeman was concerned that the lost handgun would fall into the wrong hands.
examples.vi: Viên cảnh sát lo khẩu súng ngắn bị mất sẽ rơi vào tay kẻ xấu.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To cease or fail at a regimen of self-improvement or reform; to lapse back into an old habit or addiction.

examples.en: Though he fell off the wagon several times, he eventually succeeded in quitting.
examples.vi: Dù mấy lần quay lại thói cũ, cuối cùng anh ấy cũng cai được.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To be less satisfactory than expected; to be inadequate or insufficient.

translations.text: không đạt được như yêu cầu

examples.en: I did my best, but fell far short of the score cutoff.
examples.vi: Tôi đã cố hết sức, nhưng vẫn kém điểm chuẩn khá xa.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To suffer as a result of external circumstances or someone else's actions.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

examples.en: Since the falling out with his neighbor, they have kept their distance.
examples.vi: Từ khi bất hòa với hàng xóm, họ giữ khoảng cách với nhau.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: A thing or occurrence which initially causes fear, distress, etc. but which is subsequently recognized as being no cause for concern.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To intensify or worsen an already difficult situation.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: By a large degree or margin; greatly (used before comparative and superlative adjectives).

examples.en: Their coffee is far and away the best in town.
examples.vi: Cà phê của họ ngon nhất thị trấn, bỏ xa các nơi khác.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Starkly different (from).

translations.text: khác xa một trời một vực

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

translations.text: còn lâu mới có chuyện đó

examples.en: Fat chance that I'll ever go back to Swansea.
examples.vi: Còn lâu tôi mới quay lại Swansea.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To have a desire for something, or to do something.

examples.en: I didn't feel like working yesterday, so I called in sick.
examples.vi: Hôm qua tôi chẳng muốn đi làm nên đã gọi điện báo ốm.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To suffer a hardship, especially significant financial pressure.

translations.text: lâm cảnh túng thiếu, eo hẹp

examples.en: Working-class families are feeling the pinch in the wake of the recession.
examples.vi: Các gia đình lao động đang thấm cảnh eo hẹp sau cuộc suy thoái.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Rare and scarce; hard to find.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To attempt a task or other endeavor in which there is no chance that it will succeed.

translations.text: theo đuổi việc cầm chắc thất bại

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To respond to an attack with a similar or identical counter-attack (e.g. to respond to gunfire with reciprocal gunfire).

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To deal with urgent matters and minor emergencies rather than longer-term work.

translations.text: chạy đi xử lý hết việc gấp này đến việc gấp khác

examples.en: I spent all of Monday fighting fires and didn't get a single thing done on my project.
examples.vi: Cả thứ Hai tôi chỉ lo chữa cháy việc gấp, dự án của mình chẳng làm được gì.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

examples.en: In all matters relating to the family business, mum has the final say.
examples.vi: Mọi việc liên quan đến chuyện làm ăn của gia đình, mẹ là người quyết định cuối cùng.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To criticize something excessively.

examples.en: No matter what I do, he always finds fault.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

examples.en: As you enter the cafe, you find yourself wondering why they decided to paint the entire room blue.
examples.vi: Vừa bước vào quán cà phê, bạn bỗng tự hỏi sao họ lại sơn cả căn phòng màu xanh.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: A difference, albeit vague and difficult to discern.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: The details, restrictions, terms, or conditions, especially of a contract, often printed in very small type.

translations.text: những điều khoản in chữ nhỏ

examples.en: Before signing up for such an offer, be sure to read the fine print carefully.
examples.vi: Trước khi đăng ký ưu đãi kiểu đó, nhớ đọc kỹ phần điều khoản chữ nhỏ.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Used to express that one is expectant and hoping.

examples.en: The college application is in the mail. Fingers crossed!
examples.vi: Hồ sơ xin học đại học đã gửi đi rồi. Cầu trời suôn sẻ!

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: The thing, place, or activity of which one is fondest; one's most fundamental interest or attachment.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Firstly; before anything else.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Lavish; luxurious.

translations.text: sang trọng như dành cho vua chúa

examples.en: Mum cooked us a meal fit for a king.
examples.vi: Mẹ nấu cho chúng tôi một bữa thịnh soạn như đãi vua.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: At top speed.

examples.en: After 10 minutes of running flat out, he was out of breath.
examples.vi: Sau 10 phút chạy hết tốc lực, anh ấy thở không ra hơi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To depress the accelerator to the maximum extent.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To become very angry or enraged; to throw a fit or go crazy.

examples.en: My dad flew off the handle when he saw the F grade on my report card.
examples.vi: Bố tôi nổi cơn tam bành khi thấy điểm F trong phiếu điểm của tôi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To follow an example; to imitate or copy the actions of another.

examples.en: If you are not sure of the proper etiquette, watch what others do and follow suit.
examples.vi: Nếu không chắc phép tắc thế nào, hãy xem người khác làm gì rồi làm theo.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To conform to majority beliefs, opinions, or practices.

examples.en: As much as the next guy, I don't like to follow the crowd.
examples.vi: Cũng như bao người khác, tôi không thích hùa theo đám đông.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: A hierarchy.

examples.en: With my promotion this month I will continue my steady journey to the top of the food chain.
examples.vi: Với lần thăng chức tháng này, tôi sẽ tiếp tục vững bước tiến lên đỉnh của thang bậc.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Information or knowledge that is worthy of contemplation.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To pay for something.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: As a departure from the usual (whether deliberate or not).

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Without doubt.

translations.text: chắc chắn không nghi ngờ gì

examples.en: I know this for a fact.
examples.vi: Tôi biết chắc chuyện này.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: For a very low price; very cheaply.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: In a way that is conclusive and final.

examples.en: A bad haircut is no fun, but at least you're not stuck with it for good, only until it grows out.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: In excess of the minimum required; added as an extra.

examples.en: He tossed in a couple of extra shirts for good measure and closed the suitcase.
examples.vi: Anh ấy ném thêm vài chiếc áo cho chắc rồi đóng va li.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: For the first time, after many instances to the contrary; in a rare exception to the rule; as an exception to the usual.

translations.text: hiếm hoi lắm mới có một lần

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Used to introduce one reason or example among potentially several reasons for something that has been stated or is about to be explained.

examples.en: Well, I'm having difficulties with the heating, for one thing.
examples.vi: À, trước hết là tôi đang gặp trục trặc với hệ thống sưởi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: intended to be seen but not bought or used; aesthetic as opposed to practical.

examples.en: Wealthy Nauruans spent their abundant money on cars that were for show.
examples.vi: Những người Nauru giàu có đổ khoản tiền dư dả vào những chiếc xe chỉ để trưng cho đẹp.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: as far as that is concerned.

examples.en: I didn't do it. For that matter, I didn't even know that it happened.
examples.vi: Tôi không làm. Mà nói đến chuyện đó, tôi còn chẳng biết nó đã xảy ra.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Available for someone to have something just by asking for it, i.e., without any significant effort or outlay; freely.

examples.en: All you have to do is go to the interview. The job is yours for the asking.
examples.vi: Bạn chỉ cần đi phỏng vấn. Muốn nhận là công việc thuộc về bạn.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Not deserving serious consideration; unimportant; useless, worthless.

translations.text: vớ vẩn, chẳng đáng bận tâm

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: In most aspects; mostly; generally.

examples.en: For the most part, the crowd was orderly.
examples.vi: Nhìn chung, đám đông khá trật tự.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Used to emphasize a point in an attempt to make it known or noticed.

examples.en: For the record, I think these policies are weird and unnecessary.
examples.vi: Nói cho rõ là tôi thấy mấy chính sách này kỳ quặc và không cần thiết.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Temporarily; for now; until later; until the situation changes; in an indefinite period of time.

examples.en: I think I will ignore the problem for the time being.
examples.vi: Tôi nghĩ trước mắt mình sẽ tạm bỏ qua vấn đề này.

examples.vi: Đó là ý tưởng tuyệt vời, nếu nó được ưa chuộng và bán chạy thì chúng ta sẽ đổi đời.

meanings.text: To take time off from employment; to cease working temporarily.

meanings.text: To temporarily suspend an activity in order to do something else.

translations.text: tạm gác việc để làm chuyện khác

examples.en: I took time out from my studies to travel for a year.
examples.vi: Tôi tạm nghỉ học một năm để đi du lịch.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To chit-chat; to shoot the breeze.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

examples.en: Some leaders only talk the talk but aren't prepared to take any risks.
examples.vi: Một số lãnh đạo chỉ giỏi nói chứ không sẵn sàng chấp nhận rủi ro nào.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To be completely ignored or disregarded by someone, as if speaking to an inanimate object.

translations.text: nói như nước đổ đầu vịt

examples.en: She never listens. We might as well talk to a brickwall.
examples.vi: Cô ta chẳng bao giờ nghe. Nói với cô ta như nước đổ đầu vịt.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To untruthfully speak of another in a belittling, deprecative, slighting manner, either in person or in absentia.

translations.text: nói xấu, dè bỉu người khác

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: A student who is perceived to be favored by the teacher.

examples.en: As an intelligent and conscientious student, he was often labelled as the teacher's pet in school.
examples.vi: Là học sinh thông minh và chăm chỉ, cậu thường bị gọi là trò cưng của thầy cô ở trường.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To reveal everything, particularly information that is normally withheld.

examples.en: The suspect told all when he saw the surveillance tapes linking him to the crime scene.
examples.vi: Nghi phạm khai hết khi thấy băng giám sát cho thấy hắn có liên quan đến hiện trường vụ án.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To speak frankly, to convey all and only the truth of a situation.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Used to positively assert the frank honesty of an associated statement of set of statements; equivalent to "to you tell the truth".

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To take a risk.

examples.en: Don't tempt fate by driving without a seatbelt.
examples.vi: Đừng đùa với số phận bằng cách lái xe mà không thắt dây an toàn.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Very likely to happen

translations.text: mười phần thì chắc đến chín

examples.en: She said it was an accident, but ten to one she's lying.
examples.vi: Cô ta bảo đó là tai nạn, nhưng mười phần thì chắc đến chín là cô ta nói dối.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: There is nothing more to say or to do concerning the matter and is not up for discussion or debate.

translations.text: Thế là xong, khỏi bàn thêm

examples.en: It is quite simple. You're grounded for a week and that's that!
examples.vi: Đơn giản thôi. Con bị cấm túc một tuần, khỏi bàn thêm!

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: A conclusive action has been taken, so events will proceed in an irreversible manner; the point of no return has been passed; the future is determined; there are no more options.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Only a part of something; not the full picture. Typically it is implied to be the most important part.

translations.text: mới chỉ một phần câu chuyện

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: In a way that is more difficult than necessary; by adverse experience.

translations.text: theo cách khó khăn, vất vả

examples.en: He never asks for advice; he always does things the hard way.
examples.vi: Anh ấy chẳng bao giờ hỏi ý kiến ai; lúc nào cũng tự làm theo cách khó nhọc.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Recently; lately; a few days ago.

examples.en: I saw your friend William the other day. He says hi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: One does not need to continue narrating a story as the subsequent events are assumed to be well-known.

translations.text: phần còn lại thì ai cũng biết rồi

examples.en: Sarah and I got married back in 1956 and the rest is history.
examples.vi: Sarah và tôi cưới nhau năm 1956, chuyện sau đó thì ai cũng biết rồi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

text: the straw that broke the camel's back

meanings.text: A small and seemingly insignificant addition to a burden that renders it too much to bear; the small thing which causes failure, or causes inability or unwillingness to endure any more of something.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Used to shift focus to an overriding point or impediment.

examples.en: I'd like to come, but the thing is, I just can't afford it.
examples.vi: Tôi muốn đến lắm, nhưng vấn đề là tôi không đủ tiền.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: All over the world; globally; throughout the world.

examples.en: Thomas Edison is known the whole world over as the inventor of the light-bulb.
examples.vi: Cả thế giới đều biết Thomas Edison là người phát minh ra bóng đèn.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: From another point of view; on the other hand; on second thought; again.

examples.en: I think I'll take three pairs of shoes. Then again, I only plan to stay two days.
examples.vi: Chắc tôi sẽ mang ba đôi giày. Nhưng nghĩ lại, tôi chỉ định ở có hai ngày.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Right at that moment in time and on the spot; immediately.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: On or for a round trip journey, literal or figurative.

examples.en: It took me about 20 minutes there and back.
examples.vi: Tôi mất khoảng 20 phút cả đi lẫn về.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Used to indicate that something cannot be known or predicted with certainty.

translations.text: không thể nào biết trước được

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: said after an action has been performed successfully

examples.en: When's this film supposed to begin? Ah, there we go; the lights are dimming now.
examples.vi: Bao giờ phim này mới chiếu nhỉ? À, đây rồi; đèn đang mờ dần.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: You have done it, or are doing it, correctly.

examples.en: Attagirl! There you go! Keep it up! Now pass the ball back to me again!
examples.vi: Giỏi lắm cô bé! Đúng rồi đấy! Cứ thế nhé! Giờ chuyền bóng lại cho chú nào!

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Ability to take criticism or harsh behavior without being easily offended.

translations.text: bản lĩnh không dễ tự ái khi bị chê

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: An unknown location; (by extension) apparent disappearance or nonexistence.

examples.en: Where did you think the exhaust would go? Into thin air?
examples.vi: Bạn nghĩ khí thải sẽ đi đâu? Tan vào hư không chắc?

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Something that has gone extinct or become obsolete.

translations.text: chuyện đã lùi vào dĩ vãng

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To voice one's ideas; to brainstorm.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To have a very high opinion of; to have a strong attachment to or affection for; to think highly / a lot of.

translations.text: hết mực quý mến, coi trọng

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To reconsider, use judgement; to proceed with caution or thought.

examples.en: Think twice before you go, since it could be dangerous.
examples.vi: Hãy suy nghĩ cho kỹ trước khi đi, vì có thể nguy hiểm đấy.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

translations.text: ngay lúc này, ngay lập tức

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

examples.vi: Giá nhiên liệu đã tăng vọt từ mùa thu năm ngoái.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Through all (especially grim, rough and difficult) conditions; in all weathers.

translations.text: lúc sướng cũng như lúc khổ

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

examples.en: I'd love to stay later, but my mother will throw a fit if I'm not home by 10.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

translations.text: bất chấp rủi ro mà làm

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

examples.en: The young boy liked to throw money away at the video arcade and candy store.
examples.vi: Cậu bé thích ném tiền qua cửa sổ ở tiệm trò chơi điện tử và cửa hàng kẹo.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

translations.text: vui như mở cờ trong bụng

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

examples.en: This paragraph does not tie in with the greater themes of the story.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

translations.text: hết lần này đến lần khác

examples.en: Time after time he tries, and time and again, he fails.
examples.vi: Anh ấy thử hết lần này đến lần khác, và lần nào cũng thất bại.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

translations.text: Thời gian thấm thoắt thoi đưa

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

examples.en: I've got some time off next week, so maybe we could meet up then?
examples.vi: Tuần sau tôi được nghỉ mấy hôm, hay mình gặp nhau lúc đó nhé?

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To call for a suspension of activity or conversation.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

examples.vi: Đây có thể không phải ý hay, nhưng thời gian sẽ trả lời.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

translations.text: phần nổi của tảng băng chìm

examples.en: This is only the tip of the iceberg. Our time together can become much more exciting.
examples.vi: Đây mới chỉ là phần nổi của tảng băng. Thời gian bên nhau của chúng ta còn có thể thú vị hơn nhiều.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

examples.en: I am trusting to a fault.
examples.vi: Tôi cả tin đến mức thành tật.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

translations.text: chuẩn xác đến từng chi tiết

examples.en: The announcement of the political endorsement was timed to a T.
examples.vi: Việc công bố sự ủng hộ chính trị được canh thời điểm cực kỳ chuẩn xác.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To go back and forth; to alternate.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Frankly, honestly.

examples.en: I don't mind, to be honest.
examples.vi: Thành thật mà nói, tôi không phiền đâu.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: In addition, besides, also.

examples.en: His boyfriend is funny, and a pretty good cook to boot.
examples.vi: Bạn trai của anh ấy vui tính, lại còn nấu ăn khá ngon nữa.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Until now; until the present time.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Very good; exquisite; particularly desirable.

examples.en: She makes these chocolate-peanut butter candies that are just to die for.
examples.vi: Cô ấy làm món kẹo sô-cô-la bơ đậu phộng ngon mê ly.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Served in a package or takeout container so as to be taken away from a restaurant rather than eaten on the premises.

examples.en: I'd like two burgers, two small orders of fries and two shakes, to go.
examples.vi: Cho tôi hai bánh mì kẹp thịt, hai phần khoai tây chiên nhỏ và hai ly sữa lắc, mang đi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: With no success or benefit; unsuccessfully; to no effect.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Completely, utterly.

examples.en: I just love my nieces to pieces.
examples.vi: Tôi thương mấy đứa cháu gái vô cùng.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Used to suggest an understatement.

translations.text: ấy là còn nói nhẹ đi

examples.en: The 9/11 attacks weren't very good for America. / To say the least!
examples.vi: Vụ tấn công 11/9 chẳng tốt đẹp gì cho nước Mỹ. / Nói thế còn là nhẹ đấy!

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: In abundance.

examples.en: She has talent to spare!
examples.vi: Cô ấy tài năng có thừa!

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Sufficient; important or significant enough to be worth mentioning.

examples.en: Q: How many people heeded the advice to bring an umbrella? A: Not enough to speak of.
examples.vi: Hỏi: Bao nhiêu người nghe lời khuyên mang ô? Đáp: Chẳng đáng là bao.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: An attestation to the truthfulness and frankness of an associated statement.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: For that reason, with that goal, intending to produce that result.

examples.en: He was aiming to get into the school swimming team, and to that end he swam every evening.
examples.vi: Cậu ấy muốn vào đội bơi của trường, và để đạt được điều đó, tối nào cậu cũng đi bơi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Literally, exactly, following the rules as written.

examples.en: You should follow what your boss said to the letter. Otherwise, you'll lose your job.
examples.vi: Bạn nên làm đúng y lời sếp dặn. Nếu không, bạn sẽ mất việc.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To the greatest possible extent.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Relevant or pertinent; succinct; specific.

examples.en: His letter was short and to the point.
examples.vi: Thư của anh ấy ngắn gọn và đi thẳng vào trọng tâm.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To abide by the rules or conventions; (politics, in particular) to follow the party line.

examples.en: Television shows these days do not always toe the line of decency and common sense.
examples.vi: Các chương trình truyền hình ngày nay không phải lúc nào cũng giữ đúng chuẩn mực đứng đắn và lẽ thường.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: That's a pity.

examples.en: You can't come to the party? Too bad.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Appearing to be exceptionally good, and therefore arousing suspicion of illegitimacy.

examples.en: He wants to give you two million dollars? That's just too good to be true!
examples.vi: Ông ta muốn cho anh hai triệu đô la? Chuyện tốt đến mức khó tin!

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Used to indicate that something is ineffective or useless because it happens after the best time for it.

examples.en: It was too late to turn back.
examples.vi: Đã quá muộn để quay lại.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Used as a predicate or a pro-sentence to indicate insufficiency.

examples.en: That's just half what was due last week. Too little, too late.
examples.vi: Đó mới chỉ là một nửa số phải nộp tuần trước. Quá ít, quá muộn.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Very good; of the highest level or quality.

examples.en: The award may be given to anybody who consistently writes top notch content.
examples.vi: Giải thưởng có thể trao cho bất kỳ ai thường xuyên viết nội dung chất lượng hàng đầu.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: The best, or of the highest quality, especially among a range of products.

examples.en: When you buy a top-of-the-line refrigerator, you expect it to work for many years.
examples.vi: Khi mua tủ lạnh loại cao cấp nhất, bạn mong nó dùng được nhiều năm.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Completely; entirely.

examples.en: They went through everything with a fine-toothed comb, searching the place top to bottom.
examples.vi: Họ rà soát kỹ từng li từng tí, lục soát nơi đó từ trên xuống dưới.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Completely worth the money paid for it.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: A sarcastic expression of impatience.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Expresses support, agreement, certainty or emphasis.

examples.en: You bet they'll re-run such a successful show next season.
examples.vi: Chắc chắn mùa sau họ sẽ phát lại một chương trình thành công như thế.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Indicates agreement, approval, encouragement.

examples.en: "What he did to her was wrong." "You know it, sister!"
examples.vi: "Việc hắn làm với cô ấy là sai." "Chuẩn luôn, chị ơi!"

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Used, often as a question, to get someone's attention before announcing something.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: I have something very surprising to say; you won't be able to guess what I'm about to say.

translations.text: Bạn không đời nào đoán ra đâu

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Used to express gratitude at unnecessary generosity, especially when receiving a gift.

examples.en: What a lovely vase! You shouldn't have!
examples.vi: Cái bình đẹp quá! Bạn bày vẽ làm gì!

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: A sarcastic, rhetorical response to an obvious statement.

examples.en: I reckon the trees are greener in spring than in winter. -You think?
examples.vi: Tôi cho là cây cối mùa xuân xanh hơn mùa đông. - Còn phải nói!

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Having the joy and vitality associated with younger people, despite one's own advanced age.

translations.text: tuổi cao nhưng tâm hồn vẫn trẻ

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Used to close a note or letter.

examples.en: Please write back soon! Yours truly, Alice.
examples.vi: Mong sớm nhận được thư hồi âm! Thân ái, Alice.
